doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: George 'Shamrock' Stewart and living in Oakdale
summary: Martin recalls visiting George Stewart, nicknamed Shamrock, with Russell, Slow Drag and George Lewis, and where those people lived in Oakdale. He says how long he has lived on this side of the river.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I had a... Of course, you went to his house. We called him Shamrock. His name was George Stewart.
Yeah. I didn't know that. Yeah, you know the... Remember when we went over to his house? Me, you, slow-dragging... Wait a minute. George Lewis.
I don't remember. No, I can't remember that. When was that? How long? Long ago? That's around the 40s. That far back.
I guess I just forgot about that. When he played the piano in his wife's song, son's song.
Oh, yeah. Where did they live?
Where was... They lived over in a place called Oakdale on Farragore Street.
Yeah. Yeah. Two years over there.
Yeah, that's right. I forgot about that. See, those days you were living over here on...
Oh, I've been living over here since... Dolphin, though. I've been living over here since around 19... 6. 19-6.
